title: 7 Live-Action Fox Kids Shows That Changed 90s Kids Forever
content: It’s been nearly 40 years since Fox Kids first changed Saturday mornings for a whole generation of children , but there are a few live-action shows that stand out even more from their animated counterparts after all this time.
author: ComicBook

title: 'She Loves to Cook, and She Loves to Eat' Manga Resumes After 2 Years
content: Sakaomi Yuzaki 's She Loves to Cook, and She Loves to Eat ( Tsukuritai Onna to Tabetai Onna ) manga resumed serialization on Kadokawa 's ComicWalker platform on Friday with chapter 53 after two years on hiatus. The series last published a new chapter in June 2024.

title: Actress Daveigh Chase Dies at 35
content: Chase voiced Chihiro in Studio Ghibli 's Spirited Away anime film in 2001 and Lilo in Disney's Lilo and Stitch film in 2002. She continued to voice Lilo in various films, television series, and games. She played Samara Morgan in the American live-action film The Ring .
